_note: Generated from Sochen's MCP server (POST https://sochen.dev/api/mcp, tools/list). Each tool here calls the server tool named in server_tool.

tools.name: sochen_gst_invoice
tools.title: Make a GST invoice
tools.description:
Free, with no Sochen account. Makes an Indian GST tax invoice as a PDF from details the user gives: seller and buyer names, addresses, states and GSTINs, and line items with quantity, price before GST, GST rate and HSN/SAC code. Within one state it charges CGST + SGST (half the rate each); to another state, IGST; a seller without a GSTIN gets a plain invoice with no GST. Lines are rounded to paise and the total to the nearest rupee with a round-off line, and the total is written in words. Returns the tax breakdown and a link to the PDF that works for 24 hours. Nothing is saved to an account or sent to anyone.
Use this when the user wants a GST invoice or bill for a sale of goods or services in India.
Do not use for quotations or estimates, e-invoices that need an IRN from the GST portal, e-way bills, GST return filing, or invoices in currencies other than rupees.

state.description: Indian state or union territory, e.g. Karnataka.

upi_id.description: The seller's UPI ID (name@bank), to print a pay-by-UPI QR for the total.

seller.description: The business issuing the invoice. With a GSTIN, it is a tax invoice; without one, a plain invoice with no GST.

state.description: Indian state or union territory, e.g. Karnataka.

rate.description: Price per unit before GST, in rupees.

gst_rate.description: GST rate in percent, e.g. 0, 5, 18 or 40.

invoice_number.description: The seller's own invoice number, up to 16 letters, digits, / or -. Ask for it; don't invent one.

invoice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in India.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the invoice date (payable on receipt).

place_of_supply.description: The state the supply goes to, if not the buyer's state.

notes.description: Payment terms or a note printed at the bottom.

tools.name: sochen_rent_receipts
tools.title: Make rent receipts
tools.description:
Free, with no Sochen account. Makes month-by-month house rent receipts as one PDF, three to an A4 page, for an HRA (house rent allowance) claim in India: the tenant, landlord, address, monthly rent, the months, and how it was paid. Each receipt has the amount in figures and words, a receipt number and date, a signature line, a blank line for the landlord's PAN (to write in by hand; it is needed once the year's rent passes ₹1,00,000), and a revenue stamp box for cash payments over ₹5,000. Returns a link to the PDF that works for 24 hours. Nothing is saved to an account or sent to anyone.
Use this when the user needs rent receipts for HRA, a tax declaration, or their employer.
Do not use for rental agreements or leases, receipts for anything other than house rent, or invoices from a GST-registered landlord (use sochen_gst_invoice).

tenant.description: The tenant's name, as on the HRA claim.

monthly_rent.description: Rent for one month, in rupees.

from_month.description: The first month, YYYY-MM (an HRA year usually starts 2026-04).

to_month.description: The last month, YYYY-MM. Defaults to the first month; at most 24 months.

paid_on_day.description: The day of each month the rent was paid (a shorter month uses its last day).

tools.name: sochen_upi_split
tools.title: Split a bill with UPI QRs
tools.description:
Free, with no Sochen account. Splits a shared bill that one person paid, and makes one PDF with a UPI QR card for each person who owes: scanning it in any UPI app pays the payer exactly that person's share, with a note. Splits evenly, or by items when not everyone shared everything, spreading tax, service charge and tip in proportion. A share over ₹1,999 comes as a few equal QRs of ₹1,999 or less, so no payment pays a UPI fee even into a business account. Needs the payer's UPI ID. Sochen doesn't move money; each person pays in their own app. Returns everyone's share and a link to the PDF that works for 24 hours.
Use this when the user wants to split a restaurant bill, trip, rent or any shared expense in India and collect it back over UPI.
Do not use for requesting money from strangers, business invoices (use sochen_gst_invoice), payments in other currencies, or amounts over ₹1,00,000 per person.

title.description: What the bill was for, e.g. Dinner at Toit. Shows on each QR's note.

people.description: Everyone sharing the bill, including the person who paid.

paid_by.description: The person who paid the whole bill (one of people).

paid_by_upi_id.description: The payer's UPI ID (name@bank), which everyone pays back to.

total.description: The bill's final total in rupees, with tax and tip. Needed when there are no items.

items.description: Items, when not everyone shared everything. With a total too, the difference (tax, service, tip) is spread by what each person had.

shared_by.description: Who shared this item; everyone when left out.

round_to_rupee.description: Round each share to whole rupees.
